routes.label: Four full weeks and three extra days

question: Suppose July of year \(N\) has five Mondays. Which of the following must occur five times in August of year \(N?\) (Note: Both months have \(31\) days.)
solution:
Since \(31=4\cdot7+3\), a 31-day month contains four full weeks and three extra days. The weekdays of its first three days therefore occur five times; every other weekday occurs four times.

For July to have five Mondays, Monday must fall among July 1, 2, and 3. Thus July begins on Saturday, Sunday, or Monday. From July 1 to August 1 is 31 days, so August begins three weekdays later.

If July begins on Saturday, August begins on Tuesday, and its five-occurrence weekdays are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

If July begins on Sunday, August begins on Wednesday, and its five-occurrence weekdays are Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.

If July begins on Monday, August begins on Thursday, and its five-occurrence weekdays are Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.

Thursday is the only weekday common to all three lists. Therefore the answer is \(\boxed{\text{Thursday}}\), choice D.
